[[File:UI Enemy Icon.svg|thumb|150px|Enemy Icon]]
'''Enemies''' are hostile units found throughout the many [[battle|battles]] that make up the majority of ''Mewgenics' ''gameplay. Excluding [[Mini-Bosses]] and [[Bosses]], enemies are the main threat to the player's party during [[adventures]].

Every [[Chapter]] has a unique "pool" of enemies that can only be encountered within said chapter (e.g. {{en|Peashy}} is usually only found in the {{Chapter|Desert}}), alongside a handful of enemies that can be found anywhere.

The hard path of each Chapter contains 'hard' battle nodes, which will have {{icon|Champion|link=y}} enemies in them. These are stronger versions of each enemy, with increased stats and alternate visual designs. Additionally, some Champion enemies may be {{icon|Elite|Elites|link=y}}, champions with special [[Elite Buff|Elite Buffs]] that make them even more challenging opponents. Both Champions and Elites become more common on higher [[difficulty|difficulties]].

;{{anchor|Size}}
Enemies can come in three distinct sizes that always occupy a square of tiles: 1x1, 2x2 or 3x3.
* Some of the 1x1 enemies are classified as {{anchor|small enemies}}, which gives them a unique icon in Tactical view and prevents them from attacking units with the {{p|Daunt}} passive. For a full list, see: [[:Category:Small Enemies]].
* 2x2 and 3x3 enemies are considered {{anchor|large enemies}}.
** Large enemies can't be {{st|Trample|trampled}} and {{a|Trip}} has a lower chance of working against them.

== All ==
Enemies that spawn in all chapters naturally.

=== Bonus Birds === 
Bonus Birds come in 3 sizes and 4 rarities.

* Small birds run away after 1 turn.
* Medium birds run away after 2 turns.
* Large birds run away after 3 turns.

All birds try to counterattack and relocate after being hit.

When downed, Bonus Birds grant an {{St|All Stats Up}} to the unit that dealt the killing blow. If downed by the player, Bonus Birds drop a specific [[item]] or items from the chapter item pool. A dead Bonus Bird can be resurrected and downed again for repeated stat bonuses, but will only drop an item the first time it is downed.

Note that which entity earns the stat bonus when a bird is downed can be unintuitive, especially in situations involving knockback damage, thorns, and damage over time.
